title: MultiSocial: Multilingual Benchmark of Machine-Generated Text Detection of Social-Media Texts

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of languages and language families within the dataset to identify representation skews, specifically noting the heavy overrepresentation of Indo-European languages.
Evaluating the dataset using a pre-trained multilingual toxicity detector to quantify the percentage of potentially toxic text samples across different social media platforms.
Applying social media text topic detectors and multilingual text genre classifiers to map the distribution of texts and ensure the dataset covers a wide variety of content without severe skew.
